definitions: A genus of aromatic evergreen trees and shrubs belonging to the laurel family (Lauraceae), native to tropical and subtropical Asia and Australia.
It includes species such as cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) and cassia (Cinnamomum cassia), known for their bark used as spices.
examples: The genus Cinnamomum is economically important.
Many species within the genus Cinnamomum are cultivated.
Botanists study the diversity of the genus Cinnamomum.
